sections.h2: What to secure before you choose a new platform
sections.html:
Before comparing platforms, collect everything that belongs to your institute. Most of it you can gather even if the old app no longer opens.

  1. Student list. Export it from the old admin panel if it still opens. If not, rebuild it from admission forms, fee receipts and your batch WhatsApp groups: name, phone, batch, course and validity end date.
  2. Payment records. Download statements from your payment gateway account and bank so you know who paid for what, and until when.
  3. Original content. Find the source files of your recorded lectures, PDF notes and question banks on your computer, Google Drive or YouTube. Do not rely on copies inside the old app.
  4. Your domain. Log in to the registrar where your web address was bought and check it is registered in your name. If it is, you can point it to your new academy.
  5. Your app listing. Check whether your Android app was published under your own Google Play developer account or the vendor's. If it was the vendor's, plan for students to install a new app.
{{q:My Winuall app still works. Do I need to do anything?|Yes, calmly. We could not find an official Winuall page on 24 Oct 2026, so there is no public notice of what happens next. Export students, payments and content while you can, and keep the app running for current batches until your new academy is ready.}}

Of the five, the student list and the original files matter most. With those two in hand, everything else (courses, batches, website, app) can be rebuilt on any platform.

We compared five platforms coaching institutes in India often shortlist: AllCoaching, Classplus, Learnyst, Edmingle and AppX. We checked each on its own website on 24 Oct 2026.

  1. Price you can see before signing up, from the official pricing page only.
  2. Fee on your sales, because a percentage changes the total as you grow.
  3. What you own: your domain, your app listing and your student data, and whether you can export it.
  4. How fast you can rebuild: self-serve sign-up, or a demo and setup by the vendor.
  5. Institute needs: multiple teachers, batches, tests and live classes.

sections.h2: Which Winuall alternative fits your institute
sections.html:
Small institute or single teacher (under ₹2 lakh a year)

Keep fixed costs low and rebuild quickly. A self-serve academy with a free trial lets you rebuild a batch in the trial and keep teaching. Our guide to moving coaching online covers the basics.

Multi-teacher institute

Look for separate teacher logins and batch ownership. Every AllCoaching plan includes them; the institute handles its own teacher pay. See multi-teacher coaching platforms.

Test-series institute (SSC, banking, NEET, JEE)

If mocks are most of your revenue, compare Learnyst's test engine with building tests inside your own academy. See how to create mock tests online.

Large institute with steady sales

A flat-price plan like Classplus's can win on cost above about ₹2.3 lakh a year. Weigh it against owning your domain and app. Our best LMS for coaching institutes guide compares more options.

You want someone to rebuild it for you

AppX's done-for-you setup fits here. Get the full price, renewal and change process in writing first.

sections.h2: How to move from Winuall without losing students
sections.html:
The safe way to move is to rebuild first, tell students clearly, and move batch by batch while honouring every paid validity.

{{fig:switch|Four steps to move from Winuall: secure your data, rebuild your academy, tell students with a date, move batch by batch|Students keep every day they paid for.}} {{steps}}

Two rules make this calm. First, never ask a student to pay twice: carry their remaining validity over to the new academy. Second, give one clear date and one link, and repeat it in every batch group. The full checklist, including message templates, is in how to switch coaching apps without losing students.

items: Export or rebuild your student list, download payment records, and collect original videos, PDFs and question banks.
Check your domain and app listing
Confirm the domain is registered in your name, and find out whose Google Play account your app was published under.
Start the 7-day trial, connect your domain, add teachers and upload one complete course per batch.
Send one message to every batch group with the new link, the switch date and how their paid validity carries over.
Enrol each batch in the new academy with its remaining validity, starting with the smallest batch as a pilot.
Open new admissions on your academy
Send all new students to your own website and app, and stop using the old app once the last batch has moved.

What is the best Winuall alternative for a coaching institute?

It depends on the institute. AllCoaching fits institutes that want to rebuild their own website and Android app (iOS app on Pro and Scale) themselves from ₹6,999 a year plus a fee on sales; Classplus fits institutes that want a flat listed price; Learnyst fits test-heavy academies; AppX fits owners who want it set up for them.
How do I get my student data out of Winuall?
Export it from the old admin panel if it still opens. If it does not, rebuild the list from admission forms, fee receipts, payment gateway statements and batch WhatsApp groups.
Will my students need to download a new app?
Probably, unless your old app was published under your own Google Play developer account. Plan for a new app and give students one clear link and date.
Can a coaching institute run an app without any yearly fee?
Not among the platforms we checked for institutes. AllCoaching is a yearly plan from ₹6,999 plus a fee on sales, Learnyst Launcher is ₹10,000 a year plus 10%, and Classplus lists ₹29,999 a year.
Can each teacher in my institute have their own login?
Yes. Every AllCoaching plan includes separate teacher logins and batch ownership; the institute handles its own internal teacher pay.
What does the AllCoaching Starter plan include?

Starter is ₹6,999 a year plus a 10% fee on sales, GST extra. It includes a website on your own domain, your own Android app (iOS app on Pro and Scale), unlimited live classes, unlimited YouTube videos, courses, tests, notes, UPI checkout and data export.
How long does it take to move a coaching institute to a new platform?
It depends on how much content and how many batches you have. Building one course and running a pilot batch inside a 7-day trial is realistic; plan the full move over about a month, batch by batch.
